newsitem.title: UK: Four green rates to devalue on Friday - HGCA.
newsitem.headline: Four green rates to devalue on Friday - HGCA.

text.p: The green rates of the Belgian franc, mark, guilder and the Austrian schilling will be devalued on the European Union's (EU) agrimonetary system on Friday, the UK's Home-Grown Cereals Authority (HGCA) said.

According to its calculations, the green franc will be devalued to 39.5483 Ecus from 39.5239, the green mark to 1.92047 Ecus from 1.91692, the green guilder to 2.15464 from 2.14989 and the green schilling to 13.5103 from 13.4875.
The devaluations follow from the strength of the Irish punt, which will undergo a third of up to five confirmation periods beginning on Friday for a revaluation.
Confirmation periods last 10 days, at the end of which all green currencies in the grid hovering above their market exchange rates are devalued.
